title: Workday Named a Leader in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud ERP for Service-Centric Enterprises for Fifth Consecutive Year
summary: Workday is the Only Vendor to Be Recognized as a Customers' Choice in the Latest Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for Cloud ERP for Service-Centric Enterprises PLEASANTON, Calif.,...
body_markdown:
*Workday is the Only Vendor to Be Recognized as a Customers' Choice in the Latest Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for Cloud ERP for Service-Centric Enterprises*


PLEASANTON, Calif.


, Nov. 5, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Workday, Inc.](https://www.workday.com/en-us/homepage.html) (NASDAQ: WDAY), the trusted agentic platform for HR, finance, and IT, has been named a Leader in the[2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud ERP for Service-Centric Enterprises](https://forms.workday.com/en-us/reports/gartner-financial-management-magic-quadrant-cloud-erp-service/form.html?step=step2_financial) for the fifth consecutive year. A complimentary copy of the report is available[here](https://forms.workday.com/en-us/reports/gartner-financial-management-magic-quadrant-cloud-erp-service/form.html?step=step2_financial) .


For service-centric organizations, such as professional services firms, hospitality companies, and higher education institutions, workforce and financial performance are inseparable. Yet disconnected HR and finance systems can make it difficult to understand labor costs, align staffing with demand, allocate resources effectively, and protect margins. When payroll runs, the books close, or compliance is on the line, almost right isn't good enough.


Workday operates at the heart of the enterprise, unifying people, money, and business rules on one governed platform. This gives CFOs and CIOs a shared foundation to make better-informed decisions and respond to change without sacrificing control. Workday's AI agents put that foundation to work, using the organization's business context to identify issues, recommend next steps, and carry out approved actions. By completing routine work within existing policies and permissions, agents free teams to focus on the decisions that require their judgment. Workday is trusted by thousands of organizations around the world, including David Lloyd Clubs, Drury Hotels, Forvis Mazars, MGM China Holdings Limited, Radisson Hotel Group, and University of Melbourne.


"CFOs need AI they can trust, and CIOs need AI they can govern," said Max Wessel, senior vice president of product, Workday. "Workday delivers both by grounding AI in the data, business context, and controls that already run the organization."


As the only vendor to be recognized as[a Customers' Choice by Gartner Peer Insights](https://forms.workday.com/en-gb/reports/gartner-voice-of-the-customer-cloud-erp-for-service-centric-enterprises/form.html?step=step2_default) ™ Voice of the Customer for Cloud ERP for Service-Centric Enterprises earlier this spring, Workday helps service-centric organizations break down silos between their people and financial data, bringing together the insights, processes, and controls they need to manage their operations more effectively. With AI built on this unified foundation, organizations can go beyond understanding what's happening in their business to taking action – automating work, identifying risks, and responding to change with greater speed and confidence. Workday does this through:


**One system behind every decision.** Every AI agent built on the Workday platform, whether by Workday, a customer, or a partner, runs on the same governed platform, so there's no new integration project, no separate copy of data, and no second system to monitor. For service-centric organizations, this means connecting financial and workforce insights to help identify issues earlier – whether that's catching a missing accrual before the books close, spotting staffing plans that could exceed budget, or flagging an agent operating outside its permissions before it becomes a compliance problem.


**Agents that are lawful by design.** Workday agents inherit the policies, permissions, and approval chains that already run the business, so they can take action within established business controls, not just make recommendations. This allows them to advise on the next step with the company's policy already applied, and act within each customer's controls.


**Less time navigating systems. More time getting work done.** Employees don't need to know which agent handles what; they can ask[Sana](https://www.workday.com/en-us/ai-agents/sana.html)[,](https://www.workday.com/en-us/ai-agents/sana.html) Workday's agentic experience and orchestration engine. Sana routes requests to the appropriate agents, whether built by Workday, customers, or partners, so employees don't have to navigate separate tools to get work moving. For service-centric organizations, this helps teams spend less time coordinating tasks and more time delivering services and supporting the business.


**An open platform teams can build on.** With[Developer Agent](https://www.workday.com/en-us/ai-agents/it-dev/developer.html) , teams can describe the agent they need in plain language, using the development tools they already use, and get a secure, governed agent in return. For example, finance teams could build an agent that flags supplier contracts renewing above market. IT teams could build one that automates agent access reviews. Two different teams, two different agents, one set of rules.


**A clearer view. Better-informed decisions.**[Workday Decision Intelligence](https://www.workday.com/en-us/ai-agents/decision-intelligence.html) gives teams secure access to the workforce, financial, and planning data already governed in Workday, with answers grounded in live data rather than static exports. Teams can ask questions in plain language, understand what is driving a change, and compare options. Whether evaluating a hiring plan against budget or investigating rising costs, service-centric organizations can see the broader business impact and move approved decisions into action. That means less time assembling information and more time improving business performance.
